actions.action: sustained / beyond thermal limit: immediate attention

payload.explanation: COMP1 draws up to 1.26× rated current on BOTH meter and relay CTs; the winding temperature follows the thermal model and the bus balance holds — a genuine overload, the measurements are trustworthy.
rules_fired: current above rating on both CTs
R6 temperature follows the thermal model

payload.explanation: PUMP1 meter current reads -4.7% vs the relay CT and -4.8% vs the bus balance, and the gap grew during the episode; meter internal checks (R1, R2, R5, R6) hold, so the motor is likely fine and the meter CT is drifting.
rules_fired: 2-of-3 vote: meter CT is the odd one out
R3 meter vs relay current breaks

payload.explanation: UNCERTAIN (FEW_REDUNDANT_PATHS). Leading hypothesis CORRUPTION_FALSIFICATION/ENERGY_UNDERREPORT at 0.97, runner-up SENSOR_FAULT/STUCK: AUX1 kWh register advances slower than the meter's own integrated power (R5 median z -10.0) and the bus energy balance breaks, while sensor-health checks (R1, R2, R8, R9) look fine — the energy register is under-reporting. SANAD does not conclude on intent; an operator must review.
rules_fired: R5 register increments below own integrated power

payload.label: SENSOR_FAULT
payload.reason: Register access log shows a firmware update on AUX1 meter; send to metering team, not a tampering case.
